title: pterolobium lacerans
intro: Pterolobium lacerans, commonly known as the "Indian copper leaf," is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in various medicinal practices due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Pterolobium lacerans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
